Meet Trojan Diner & Sports Bar

A diner and sports bar with a full bar

Trojan Diner & Sports Bar is a diner and sports bar located on Lincoln Way East in Chambersburg, PA. Open daily from 6:00 AM to 9:30 PM, the establishment offers a range of classic diner menu items including omelettes, entrees, steaks, and broiled seafood.

Popular dishes at Trojan Diner & Sports Bar include the breakfast panini, spaghetti with meatballs, steak and eggs, and crab cakes. The menu also features special items during Chambersburg Chamber ChambersFest Restaurant Week, such as the Farmhouse Fire Burger and the Summer Berry Chicken Salad for $16.99.

The diner is known for its full bar and is a popular spot for locals and visitors alike. Gift cards are available in person only.

Walk-ins welcome

Trojan Diner & Sports Bar is a walk-in diner. You can call them directly or visit their Facebook page for more information.
